narrative.overview:
Checky reads like ink on paper: a paper ground, near-black ink, generous round shapes, Bricolage Grotesque for every word and Cormorant Garamond italic only for what someone actually said. Colour lives on verdicts and nowhere else. The same world serves the newsroom desk (`/w/…`) and the public site (`/`, `/verifies`, `/signaler`, `/suivi`, sign-in and sign-up).

The desk has no rail: a quiet top bar says where you are (wordmark and workspace, an ink tab island with a sliding paper pill, the avatar), and the corners hold what you can do: the preference dock bottom-left, the Checky button bottom-right, out of which the assistant grows. The organising device of every screen is the **numbered line**: 1 L'affirmation, 2 Les éléments, 3 La conclusion.
keyCharacteristics: Colour only on verdicts; everything else is ink, paper and their tints (image examination uses its own teal scale, never a verdict colour).
One typeface for everything (Bricolage Grotesque), one italic serif for verbatim quotations and the wordmark dot.
Generous radius: cards 20, controls and chips fully round, menus 18, small tags 6.
Verdicts always icon + word on their own four-token family; AI suggestion dashed, confirmed solid.
Shadows only on what floats (menus, dialogs, the corners, toasts); depth elsewhere is tone and hairline.
The desk shell: tab island centred, preference dock and Checky button in the corners on the bar's 24 px inset, canvas gutters so the corners never cover content.

rules.name: The Colour-Is-Verdict Rule
rules.body: No hue outside the four verdict families (and the teal of image examination). The one action of a screen is the ink primary; the citron of the previous identity is gone.

rules.name: The Word-and-Icon Rule
rules.body: A verdict is always its Phosphor duotone icon (`lib/icons.ts`) plus its word in the verdict's ink. Colour alone never carries a verdict.

rules.name: The Paired-Token Rule
rules.body: Every filled background is used with its own foreground: primary / primary-foreground (hover primary-hover, same label), nav / nav-foreground, nav-active / nav-active-foreground (the fixed ink in both themes), verdict soft / ink, verdict fill / on, tag-inverted, toast. A class that sets one without the other is a bug.

rules.name: The Status-Is-Not-Truth Rule
rules.body: Workflow status uses ink icons, never a verdict colour.

rules.name: The 4.5 Rule
rules.body: Every text pair is at least 4.5:1 in both themes against its real ground (`lib/tokens.ts`, `npm test`). No opacity on text; placeholders and disabled labels use muted-foreground. Focus is a 2 px ring in the text colour, 3 px offset.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and headings are sentence case. No uppercase tracked eyebrow or kicker above a heading; meta sits under the title.

rules.name: The Quote Rule
rules.body: Cormorant Garamond italic (`.quote`) is for verbatim words (the verdict quote, a source's phrase, a transcript line) and the wordmark dot, nothing else.

rules.name: The Corner Rule
rules.body: Only the preference dock and the Checky button float, on the top bar's inset; from 901 px the canvas keeps gutters of inset + 84 px so they never cover content. A shadow means "this floats", never "this is important".

dos: **Do** build every screen from these tokens: `.page-title` H1 with meta under it, the check field, `StepLine`/`StepDisc`, the verdict components, the live panel.
**Do** use exactly one primary button per screen.
**Do** draw an AI suggestion dashed and a journalist's confirmation solid; the final verdict is a journalist's click.
**Do** pair every verdict with its icon and word, and every status with an ink icon from `lib/icons.ts`.
**Do** measure a new text pair in light and dark (`lib/tokens.ts`, `npm test`).
**Do** keep the canvas gutters so the floating corners never cover content; the assistant opens as a panel growing out of the Checky corner.
**Do** keep motion single-shot except the active step and recording indicators, and honour `prefers-reduced-motion` (no ripple, instant theme switch).
**Do** handle real data: long titles wrap, URLs truncate in the middle with the full URL in `title`, a missing value is a grey dash, plurals are French.
donts: **Don't** add a colour that is not a verdict (or the image teal); no gradient, no accent.
**Don't** carry a verdict by colour alone, or colour a status or an AI trace with a verdict family.
**Don't** set a filled background without its own foreground token; theme text on the paper nav pill is 1:1 in dark.
**Don't** put an uppercase tracked eyebrow above a heading, or coloured border-left accents.
**Don't** set text in opacity or in the `input` stroke colour.
**Don't** add ambient shadows to cards, or float anything besides the two corners, menus, dialogs and toasts.
**Don't** set verbatim quotations in the sans, or other text in Cormorant.
**Don't** bring back the retired worlds (citron and chalk, Archivo, Atkinson, « Grille d'antenne », « Le dossier »).
